outcome: Composite maternal outcome (antepartum hemorrhage, preterm delivery, cesarean section)
cohort: The study included patients in New York State who underwent cholecystectomy within 3 months before or after childbirth between 2005 and 2014, and all patients who underwent cholecystectomy during pregnancy.
finding: Third-trimester antepartum cholecystectomy was associated with longer length of stay and a greater incidence of preterm delivery compared to postpartum cholecystectomy.
mod_finding: Cholecystectomy timing was not independently associated with differences in the composite maternal outcome, which included cesarean section.
followup_time: Outcomes were observed up to 30 days post-procedure, for surgeries performed up to 3 months postpartum.
